<translate>
<!--T:9-->
'''Meteor Burst''' is a long strike combo that lasts about 10 seconds and mixes strikes, a slam and ki blasts. It is a rare reward of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] world boss, and unlike most strike attacks it scales with both your Strike Damage (SKP) and your Ki Damage (PWR).
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
No master teaches Meteor Burst by default. It has a '''15%''' chance to drop from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] world boss (the server default; see [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World Bosses]]). Server owners can also add it to a master's list, where it costs '''24,000 TP''', and admins can grant it with {{Command|/dmztech add}}.

<!--T:12-->
You need [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], an empty main hand and at least 5% Power Release, and the technique must be equipped in a technique slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== How it works == <!--T:13-->

<!--T:14-->
Press the technique's slot key. If an enemy is in reach in front of you (your lock-on target first, then the last enemy you hit, otherwise the one closest to your crosshair) within a 6-block cone, or 12 blocks while flying, the combo starts on it right away. Otherwise you rush forward for up to 2 seconds, or straight at your locked-on target, and the combo starts on the first enemy you reach. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]].

<!--T:15-->
The combo then plays out over about '''10 seconds''':

<!--T:16-->
# You dash in with a punch and launch the target into the air with an uppercut.
# You rise above it and stomp it back down, vanish, reappear beneath it for a knee strike and hammer it into the ground.
# You leap back, step up to the fallen target, charge a ball of ki in your hand, fire six ki blasts into it and finish with a ki explosion.

<!--T:17-->
The five blows share your Strike Damage × 2.6: 15% for the punch, 15% for the uppercut, 20% for the stomp, 15% for the knee and 35% for the hammer. The ki part deals damage based on 1.5 × your Ki Damage: 10% of it for each of the six blasts and 40% for the explosion.

<!--T:18-->
The target is carried through the whole combo; world bosses and giant multi-part enemies can't be carried, so they are pinned in place instead. Being stunned or knocked down cuts the combo short.

<!--T:19-->
Meteor Burst has the longest cooldown of any strike attack: '''30 seconds'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Enemies that use it == <!--T:20-->

<!--T:21-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Turles|Turles]] uses Meteor Burst both as a world boss and as a story enemy in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]]. In the story he rushes at you from up to 24 blocks away when he can see you; if your own strike rush meets his head-on, the two of you [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Clash|clash]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Upgrades == <!--T:22-->

<!--T:23-->
Like every strike attack, it gains experience when it hits, which you can spend on damage and cooldown (−2.5% per level, up to −50%). See [[Special:MyLanguage/Strike Attacks|Strike Attacks]].
</translate>
